sections.title: Programme scene styling
sections.what: Styles the whole programme page: the header and tool row, the floating subtitle, the playback bar, the inspector, and the shared dock and checklist controls.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond a comment about the full-bleed workspace.
sections.watch_out: Duplicate rules are overridden by later ones, so edit the last matching rule or delete the duplicates.

summary: Styles the programme scene page: a full-height layout, floating controls over the 3D stage, the subtitle box, the playback bar, the inspector panel, and shared workspace controls.
purpose: Visual layout for the programme view.
why: Reason not stated in the code. A comment says the workspace is full-bleed so the scene fills the stage.
how: Sets dark colours and layout for the header, tool row, stage, subtitles, playback bar and inspector. Later rules override earlier ones for some elements. The end of the file restyles shared workspace parts inside this page.
inputs: Class names used by the programme scene components, plus some shared variables.
risks: Several rules are repeated with different values, so the later one wins and the earlier one has no effect. Fixed dark colours may not match the rest of the app.
debug: If a rule seems to have no effect, search for the same selector further down the file. If the playback bar sits behind the canvas, check the z-index values.
